name: Terrible Triad Injury of the Elbow
tags: terrible triad injury of the elbow
definition: Combination of elbow dislocation, radial head fracture and coronoid fracture producing major instability.

investigations.principle: Radiographs and CT are essential after reduction to define fracture pattern.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, cartilage, occult injury, postoperative or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

green: Urgent reduction and orthopedic trauma care
amber: Operative stabilization is frequently required to restore a stable functional arc.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Kurpara bhagna-Sandhi complex injury phenotype may be documented after emergency care.

patientEducation.summary: Combination of elbow dislocation, radial head fracture and coronoid fracture producing major instability.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, respiratory distress, progressive neurological deficit, open injury, severe deformity, infection or other listed red flags.
